---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
---

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the use case. "I'm trying to X but currently Y prevents that" works well.

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see? Be as concrete as you can.

## Alternatives considered

If you've thought of other ways to solve the same problem, list them and explain why your proposal is better/simpler/etc.

## Phase 1 or Phase 2?

- Phase 1 is read-only display on Wemos D1 mini
- Phase 2 is the planned ESP32 + TFT + encoder build with local control

Most new features land in Phase 2. Phase 1 is mostly closed for new features once field-tested.
